description: This file defines an abstract Android Fragment class 'ChangeLogFragment' and its nested classes, including 'FullChangeLogFragment' and 'LatestChangeLogViewFactory', which are responsible for displaying change logs within the app. It includes methods for inflating views, binding data, and creating UI components related to change logs.

classes.name: ChangeLogFragment
classes.description: An abstract Fragment class for displaying change logs, with nested classes for full log display and a factory for creating log views.

classes.name: ChangeLogFragment.FullChangeLogFragment
classes.description: A concrete implementation of ChangeLogFragment that displays a list of change logs using RecyclerView.

classes.name: ChangeLogFragment.LatestChangeLogViewFactory
classes.description: A utility class with a static method to create a view for the latest change log with a 'read more' link.

classes.name: ChangeLogFragment.ChangeLogViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder for holding references to the change log item views.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the main layout for the fragment.

methods.name: fillViewForLogItem
methods.description: Populates a view holder with change log data, including title, bullet points, and URL.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the activity title when the fragment starts.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerView with adapter and layout manager.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds change log data to the view holder.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for each change log item.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of change log entries.

methods.name: getMainLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout resource ID for the fragment.

methods.name: createLatestChangeLogView
methods.description: Creates a view for the latest change log with a 'read more' link and populates it.

methods.name: ChangeLogViewHolder
methods.description: Holds references to views within a change log item layout.
